annotations.text:
Flow: Home → pick a project → Sources / Scenes / Timelines / Outputs are filtered to it.
Open a timeline → Builder shows it with a back button. Switch projects any time from the sidebar switcher (⌘⇧P); each project reopens exactly as left.
Sidebar: PROJECT group (filtered) above STUDIO group (profile-wide). AI Wizard becomes a button in Timelines and Sources. Resources screens collapse into one with tabs.
